bull_bear.body: The company's focus on sustainability and renewable energy could provide a competitive advantage in the market
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Dividend: "The Company has paid a dividend of 100% i.e., Rs. 10 per equity share of Rs. 10 each, for 2025-26 on 1 August 2026", recommended by the Board and approved by shareholders at the AGM.
- Cost of debt disclosed: average cost of long-term borrowings 7.98% and short-term borrowings 6.65% for Q1FY27.
- Inventory as the working-capital swing factor: stock as on 30 June 2026 of Rs 801 Cr (Sugar Rs 692 Cr; Molasses/Ethanol/Other Rs 109 Cr) versus Rs 923 Crores as on 30 June 2025; "Inventory carrying cost remains critical" is listed as a watch point.
- Ownership as on 30 June 2026: Promoters 60%, Individual/HUF 30%, Others 8%, FII/FPI 1%, NRI/Foreign Nationals 1%; free float 40%, market cap Rs 940 Cr, free-float market cap Rs 373 Cr, shares outstanding 20 Cr.

business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
- Lineage and structure: "Avadh Sugar & Energy Ltd incorporated in 1932 (Group in Sugar Business over 9 decades), pursuant to the scheme of merger and demerger this company formed in 2015, Manufacturing Sugar, Ethanol and Power" — the deck carries both the 1932 incorporation and the 2015 formation.
- Patronage of the K.K. Birla Group, "Established in 1932 by Late Dr. Krishna Kumar Birla", with claims of "Excellent Corporate Governance" and "Highly Experienced Management".
- Strategic location in Uttar Pradesh, described as the "largest Sugar producing State in India"; four units span West, Central and East UP (Seohara, Rosa, Hargaon, Hata).
- Reach and standing: 2.9 lac farmers connected, distribution across 6 states, and a long-term credit rating of A+.
- Three-engine framing: sugar as "A Disciplined Core Business Anchors Earnings Through The Cycle", distillery as "A Non-cyclical Earnings Lever Embedded Within The Sugar Ecosystem", and co-gen as "Value Extraction Beyond Sugar With Limited Downside Risk".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Cane pricing] "The Government raises Sugarcane FRP for SS 2026-27 by 2.81% to Rs. 365/qtl. up from Rs. 355/qtl."; a listed risk is an FRP/SAP increase "without corresponding sugar price increases".
- [Ethanol policy] "Ethanol blending has reached 20% as on 30 June 2026, on course to achieve target of 20%", with blending progressing 10.02% (ESY 21-22) to 19.17% (ESY 24-25); NITI Aayog "is working on a roadmap for blending targets beyond E20". OMC contracted quantity shown at 1,132 Cr Ltrs in ESY 24-25 and 1,048 Cr Ltrs for ESY 25-26 till 30 June 2026.
- [Company ethanol allocation] For ESY 2025-26 up to 24 July 2026 the company's own allocation/supply (Cr Ltrs) was Juice 1.71 allocated / 1.69 supplied, B-Heavy 4.78 / 3.69, C-Heavy 1.05 / 0.99 — total 7.54 allocated against 6.37 supplied.
- [Supply-demand] Company estimate for SS 2025-26: opening stock 47.00 lac tons, production 278.00, total availability 325.00, domestic consumption 270.00, exports 8.00, closing stock 47.00 — "sufficient to meet around two month's domestic consumption"; exports for SS 2026-27 depend on post-monsoon production estimates "only after September 2026".
- [Regulatory intervention] "To moderate the recent increase in sugar prices, the Government has imposed stock holding limits of up to 4,000 quintals of sugar at any time or location for every dealer."
- [Competition for cane] "Competition from the jaggery and khandsari sectors is expected to intensify due to the growing demand for natural sweeteners, which may impact cane availability for sugar mills."

deepdive.thesis: Avadh Sugar & Energy Limited is a leading manufacturer of sugar and energy products, with a strong focus on sustainability and renewable energy. The company has a diverse portfolio of products and a significant presence in the Indian market. With a stable credit rating of IND A+ from India Ratings and Research, the company is well-positioned for growth and expansion.
